title: Three Summers and One Short Comb
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：hair　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hair 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the barber ① cut the hair that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the cutting was the whole of the summer. The ② hair, meaning the strands themselves and not the wig, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; hair, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of hair in that shop had the same short comb beside it, and the ④ hair at the far chair, meaning the style they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Hair, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the barber said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hair was the whole of the matter, meaning the colour and not the strands. The ⑥ hair, meaning the colour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hair, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a strand and a colour. He said the colour is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ hair had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short comb. The ⑧ hair of the whole thing, the barber wrote in November, was one shop and three summers of describing; hair, he said, is either the style at the far chair or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hair I remember is the hair described in the note, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. ⑩ Hair, my mother said in 1975, is the only part that improves by being described; all hair, she said, is a colour that has agreed to look like a strand. She said the colour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 头发；毛发（指店里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 头发；毛发（指那些发丝本身，与假发相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the hair 剪头发
D. n. 发型（指留给孩子们学的那一种）
E. n. 毛发（抽象总称，指一家铺子的理发之事）
F. n. 头发（指便条里写到、被记下的那一式）
G. n. 毫厘；细微之差（a hair's breadth，指一件事里人人都争却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分毫（抽象总称，指人人都争却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the hair that no customer in the shop would have described
The hair, meaning the strands themselves and not the wig
Every kind of hair in that shop
the hair at the far chair
the hair was the whole of the matter
the hair had become a line in a note
The hair of the whole thing

answers.why: cut the hair 意为“剪头发”，1966 年那位理发师剪了店里没有一位顾客肯描述的头发。
hair 意为“头发、毛发”，指那些发丝本身而不是假发，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
hair 意为“头发、毛发”，指店里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把矮矮的梳子。
hair 意为“发型”，指最远那张椅子上留给孩子们学的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hair 意为“毫厘、细微之差”，指一件事里人人都争却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分毫就是那件事的全部。
hair 意为“分毫”，指人人都争却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些头发，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hair 意为“头发”，指便条里写到、被记下的那一式，到 1971 年这一式成了便条里的一行。
hair 意为“毛发”，理发师十一月写道，整件事的理发之事是一家铺子和三个夏天的描述。
hair 意为“头发”，我记得的是便条里描述过的那一式，1973 年剃掉了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一式。
hair 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，头发是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的部分。
